dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting the real flux scale.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It must be positive and multiplies each neighboring edge-flux difference.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The generic update U_i − λ • (F_{i+1} − F_i) for a cell field U, edge-flux field F, and real scale λ.

binders: E is an arbitrary additive commutative group equipped with a module structure over Real.

data is a finite-volume update record containing cell averages U : Nat → E, physical edge fluxes, a numerical-flux operator, a flux-approximation relation, a real flux scale, and updated cell averages.
conclusions: LocalDef001 data holds if and only if data.fluxScale is strictly positive, every computed numerical edge flux is related by data.isPhysicalFluxApproximation to the stored physical edge flux at that edge, and for every natural-number cell index i the updated value is U_i − data.fluxScale • (F_{i+1} − F_i), with F = data.numericalFluxFromCellAverages U.
mathematical_definitions: For a scale λ, cell field U, and edge-flux field F, LocalDef009 λ U F i = U(i) − λ • (F(i+1) − F(i)).
The numerical edge-flux field used throughout is F(edge) = data.numericalFluxFromCellAverages data.cellAverages edge.
LocalDef001 is definitionally the conjunction of scale positivity, per-edge approximation, and the per-cell update equation.
translation.proposition_plain_english: The named finite-volume update property is precisely the statement that the flux scale is positive, the numerical flux computed from the cell averages is declared an approximation to the supplied physical flux at every edge, and every new cell value is obtained by subtracting the scaled outgoing-minus-incoming numerical flux.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The theorem is only an unfolding equivalence for LocalDef001.
The relation called isPhysicalFluxApproximation is arbitrary and need not express equality, closeness, consistency, or any quantitative error bound.
The supplied physical edge fluxes are otherwise unconstrained and are not defined from a physical flux function.
Only positivity of the scale is required; there is no CFL bound or identification with Δt/Δx.
Indices are Nat, and the formula always uses i+1; no domain boundary, left ghost edge, or finite mesh is modeled.
E is an arbitrary real module, so no norm, order, componentwise physical state set, or topology is available.
No conservation theorem, accuracy order, stability, consistency, monotonicity, or convergence result is asserted.
ambiguities: The mathematical content of the approximation predicate is not specified.
The intended mesh geometry and interpretation of the scale and edge numbering are not encoded.
